name: Bus Cap Berhad
overview: Bus Cap Berhad 今年与 BYD Malaysia 签署谅解备忘录，拟在 Perak 设立电动巴士及相关辅助产品的本地组装与制造设施；并与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，涉及充电站基础设施、技术支持及半散件组装等合作。公司于今年完成 IPO 并在 ACE Market 上市。
overview_en: Bus Cap Berhad entered into a memorandum of understanding with BYD Malaysia this year to pursue the proposed establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products; it also entered into a memorandum of strategic collaboration with Starcharge Energy covering charging station infrastructure, technical support and semi-knocked-down assembly. The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market this year.

segments.name: 巴士车身制造
segments.note: 今年公司拟通过合作在 Perak 设立电动巴士及相关辅助产品的本地组装与制造设施。
segments.note_en: This year the company proposed to establish a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products through a collaboration.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 BYD Malaysia 签署谅解备忘录，拟在 Perak 设立电动巴士及相关辅助产品的本地组装与制造设施。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with BYD Malaysia to pursue the proposed establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公司与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，涉及充电站基础设施、技术支持及半散件组装等合作。
segments.note_en: This year the company entered into a memorandum of strategic collaboration with Starcharge Energy covering charging station infrastructure, technical support and semi-knocked-down assembly.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，涉及充电站基础设施、技术支持及半散件组装、销售、维护、安装和本地化等合作。
actions.text_en: Entered into a memorandum of strategic collaboration with Starcharge Energy involving charging station infrastructure, technical support and know-how, and subsequent semi-knocked-down assembly, sales, maintenance, installation and localisation initiatives.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 BYD Malaysia 签署谅解备忘录，拟在 Perak 设立电动巴士及相关辅助产品的本地组装与制造设施，涉及新能源商用车平台。
model_changes.text_en: Entered into an MOU with BYD Malaysia to pursue a Malaysia-based new energy commercial vehicle platform, including the proposed establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，合作范围包括充电站基础设施及半散件组装等，涉及充电基础设施业务。
model_changes.text_en: Entered into a memorandum of strategic collaboration with Starcharge Energy covering charging station infrastructure and semi-knocked-down assembly, involving charging infrastructure business.
